description: extensions/identity.md, anchor lists: an entry of unknown shape fails the whole list (0.13.1). Each case is one pg.anchors.v1 list from registry TEST, signed at test time with the registry key of answers.json (sha256 of 'pregen-answer-vector-registry'), checked against its directory at its `now`. Each code becomes an entry {anchor: 'wikidata:Q11571', code, level: 'verified', proof_url: '', status: 'active'}. `keep` lists the codes a client keeps; `error` is a substring of the refusal.

cases.name: known shapes: own kept, other registries' codes dropped
the TOG spelling of an own code fails the list
a new TOG person of this registry fails the list
a TOG person of another registry fails the list, it is not dropped
a TOG event code fails the list
a list of TOG codes only fails
a code with a space fails the list
an empty code fails the list
